","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":14,"lineHeight":1.7,"color":"#3E4845","align":["left","top"]}},{"elementId":"ft-mark","elementType":"image","bounds":[56,505,16,16],"src":"media/.huandeng-versions/6b49274a35445235b8ab17f805b83cf3c7f8924630a5ce5ef8455e59aba5faef.png","sourceName":"huandeng.png","fit":{"mode":"contain"}},{"elementId":"ft-label","elementType":"text","bounds":[78,505,600,16],"content":{"text":"HUANDENG / 和 agent 一起工作 · 示意图","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#7A8480","align":["left","middle"]}},{"elementId":"ft-pos","elementType":"text","bounds":[824,505,80,16],"content":{"text":"0","fontFamily":"Microsoft YaHei","fontSize":11,"lineHeight":1.3,"color":"#7A8480","align":["right","middle"],"field":"main-position"}}] notes: "你继续用自己已经在用的 AI 客户端。Codex 和 Claude Code 在本地通过 MCP 加载幻灯插件；DeepSeek Harness 用的是原生插件包；ChatGPT 通过现有的 DC-WALT 工作站连接接入。不管哪个客户端，每一次写入都经过编辑器窗口也在用的那个共享写入器。它确认 agent 读到的是当前版本，只写入预览过的那份修改，并返回回执。所以 agent 不能悄悄覆盖我一分钟前改过的东西。这份中文版就是 Claude Code 沿着这条路径写进来的。"
